argv:
import copy,hashlib,json,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
from jsonschema import Draft202012Validator
old=json.loads(subprocess.check_output(['git','show','HEAD:.agent/contracts/127.json']))
c=json.loads(Path('.agent/contracts/127.json').read_text())
Draft202012Validator(json.load(open('.nizam/schema/contract.schema.json'))).validate(c)
assert c['status']=='proposed' and c['contract_attempt']==2
assert c['approvals']=={'validator_mode_a':False,'evaluator_contract_review':False,'revisions':1}
assert c['scope']['files_modify'][:len(old['scope']['files_modify'])]==old['scope']['files_modify']
assert c['scope']['files_create'][0]['path']==old['scope']['files_create'][0]['path']
assert c['non_goals'][:2]==old['non_goals'][:2]
expected_create={'.agent/validator/127-*.json','.agent/qa/127*.json','.agent/evidence/127-qa-adversarial.txt'}
expected_modify={'.agent/contracts/127.json','.agent/run_state.json','.agent/feature_list_016.json','docs/planning/phase_016.yaml','docs/planning/ROADMAP.md','docs/planning/HANDOVER.md'}
assert {x['path'] for x in c['scope']['files_create'][1:]}==expected_create
assert {x['path'] for x in c['scope']['files_modify'][len(old['scope']['files_modify']):]}==expected_modify
normalized=copy.deepcopy(c)
for key in ('scope','non_goals','contract_attempt','approvals'): normalized[key]=old[key]
assert normalized==old, 'Unexpected interface/command/baseline/budget or unrelated field change'
feature=next(x for x in json.load(open('.agent/feature_list_016.json'))['features'] if x['id']=='127')
assert [x['command'] for x in c['verification']]==feature['acceptance_tests']
changed=subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--name-only','HEAD'],text=True).splitlines()
assert changed==['.agent/contracts/127.json']
print('PASS installed contract schema; proposed attempt2/unapproved revisions1; exact5 commands; ownership-only additions; original product scopes preserved; every unrelated field exactly equal; no source/test/state edits')
print('preserved_projection_sha256='+hashlib.sha256(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in c.items() if k not in ('scope','non_goals','contract_attempt','approvals')},sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':')).encode()).hexdigest())
